All four tasks are committed locally. Here's a summary of what was done:

---

## SP-56 — Implementation Summary

**4 commits on `agent/sp-56`**, no push.

### Task 1 — Liquid Glass Surface (`2f76438`)
- Added shared `.glass-surface` utility class in `styles.css` (blur 28px / saturate 180% / rgba(255,255,255,0.55)) — extracted from the existing `.pill`/`.bubble` token values
- Restyled `.ref-modal-stage`: replaces opaque `#fafafa` card with glass; higher opacity (0.82) and stronger shadow for modal depth
- Restyled `.ref-modal-tab`/`.ref-modal-tab.active`: glass pill treatment with inset highlights
- Restyled `.ref-modal-drop`: glass background with white dashed border
- Restyled `.ref-modal-clear`: glass-surface class applied; `.ref-modal-done` keeps accent color (primary CTA)
- Applied `glass-surface` class in `index.html` to modal card, dropzone, and clear button; added `id="ref-modal-tabs"` stub and `#steer-section` placeholder

### Task 2 — Steer Dropdowns (`106f6a4`)
- `STEER_SETS` config in `app.js` co-located with `FLOWS`: sketch → Spread/Form/Complexity; system-split-4x5 (Render) + in-situ → Color/Weight; product-shot → Form/Complexity
- `MORE_STEER` secondary dropdown (era/register + custom free text) applied to every stage
- `sessionSteers` state + `stageSteerState()` lazy accessor (mirrors `sessionRefs` pattern)
- `renderRefTabs()`: dynamic tab generation from all flow stages that have refs OR steers — logos now shows both Sketch and Render tabs
- `renderSteerDropdowns(stage)`: renders "Guide the prompt" trigger pills + glass menus; hidden if no steer set for stage
- Delegated tab listener replaces static `querySelectorAll`; `initSteerListeners()` handles toggle/pick/custom-clear
- `.steer-*` CSS: trigger pills at 12px gap, glass dropdown menus, active/pick states, `steer-opt--custom` with divider

### Task 3 — Stack/Persist/Clear (`883a81b`)
- `clearRefs()` extended: resets `sessionSteers[stage] = {}` alongside refs, then re-renders steer dropdowns — "Clear this stage" clears both in one tap
- Stack/persist confirmed: multiple dropdowns hold independent picks simultaneously; `sessionSteers` is module-level so picks survive modal close/reopen

### Task 4 — Steer Phrase Reaches Prompt (`64b8bf5`)
- `getSteerClause(stage)`: joins all active picks (primary + era + custom) as `'; '`-delimited string
- `submitGenerate()`: includes `steer_note` in POST body for fresh runs
- `amplifyOne()`: merges steer clause into `parents[].note` via `noteParts.join('; ')` — reuses existing amplify-note path
- `public.js`: extracts `steer_note`, validates/trims, passes as `steerNote` to `runBatch`
- `orchestrator.js`: for fresh runs (no parents), appends steer clause to each title via the same comma-join fusion as `parents[].note` — no new pipeline

**Visual/Playwright verification: pending human review.**
